finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Open issues in `bench/bench-repo` whose titles start with `Seed:` (read-only, unmodified):
- `#1 — Seed: triage inbox`
- `#2 — Seed: order missing parts`
- `#3 — Seed: ship repaired device`
(The issues list showed 3 Open / 0 Closed at the time of reading.)

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Issue titled `fwgt14-n1 Bench Issue` exists in `bench/bench-repo` with description: `This issue references fwgt14-n1 for tracking.` (contains the runid).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The issue's sidebar shows exactly the two labels `bug` and `priority-high` (verified after a full page reload, so they persisted server-side).

**Objective 4 — DONE.** The issue is assigned to `bench-assignee` (display name "Bench Assignee"), shown in the sidebar Assignees section.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** The issue's milestone is `Bench Milestone`, shown in the sidebar Milestone section.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** A comment exists on the issue containing the runid: `fwgt14-n1 comment: verified by SiteLooper run fwgt14-n1.` (posted by «redacted»).

**Objective 7 — DONE.** The issue's number as displayed by Gitea is `#4` (page heading: `fwgt14-n1 Bench Issue #4`; URL `/bench/bench-repo/issues/4`).

Notes: One instruction (setting labels) initially came back blocked because Gitea's sidebar combo only commits its diff when the dropdown closes; it was retried on the fallback model, which ticked both labels and closed the menu, committing them. All sidebar values (labels, assignee, milestone) and the comment were each confirmed by reloading the issue page afterwards.
